standard.summary: 决定每张图被分到哪个桶。10 个取值实际是 4 组语义：aspect 比宽高比（默认）、area/pixel/pixels 比面积、larger/ceil/no_downscale 永不缩小、smaller/floor/no_upscale 永不放大。
standard.effect: 只影响「图片 → 桶」的匹配方式，不改变桶表本身。填了自定义桶列表（bucket_custom_resos）时，桶表以那边为准，本字段仍决定怎么往里分。
standard.whenToUse: 素材构图重要就用 aspect；素材尺寸杂但想保住细节量可试 area；明确不想让训练图被放大（怕糊）用 smaller 一族，不想被缩小（怕丢细节）用 larger 一族。
standard.avoidWhen: larger 一族在素材普遍大于所有桶时会筛空，smaller 一族在素材普遍小于所有桶时同理，此时会回落到兜底桶。素材尺寸跨度很大时优先 aspect。

optionDescriptions.aspect: 默认。挑宽高比最接近原图的桶，最不容易改变构图。
optionDescriptions.area: 挑总像素数最接近原图的桶，倾向保住细节量而不是构图比例。
optionDescriptions.pixel: 与 area 等价（后端同一分支）。
optionDescriptions.pixels: 与 area 等价（后端同一分支）。
optionDescriptions.larger: 只考虑宽高都不小于原图的桶，再取其中最小的一个 —— 永不缩小，代价是可能留边。
optionDescriptions.ceil: 与 larger 等价（后端同一分支）。
optionDescriptions.no_downscale: 与 larger 等价（后端同一分支）。
optionDescriptions.smaller: 只考虑宽高都不大于原图的桶，再取其中最大的一个 —— 永不放大，代价是丢一点分辨率。
optionDescriptions.floor: 与 smaller 等价（后端同一分支）。
optionDescriptions.no_upscale: 与 smaller 等价（后端同一分支）。

standard_en.summary: Decides which bucket each image lands in. The ten values are really four groups: aspect matches aspect ratio (the default), area/pixel/pixels match area, larger/ceil/no_downscale never shrink, and smaller/floor/no_upscale never enlarge.
standard_en.effect: It only affects how an image is matched to a bucket, never the bucket table itself. When a custom bucket list (bucket_custom_resos) is filled in, that list defines the table and this field still decides how images are sorted into it.
standard_en.whenToUse: Use aspect when composition matters; try area when sizes are mixed but you want to keep the amount of detail; use the smaller family when training images must never be enlarged (to avoid blur), and the larger family when they must never be shrunk (to avoid losing detail).
standard_en.avoidWhen: The larger family filters everything out when the material is generally bigger than every bucket, and the smaller family does the same when it is generally smaller; in that case matching falls back to the default bucket. Prefer aspect when sizes vary a great deal.

optionDescriptions.aspect: The default. Picks the bucket whose aspect ratio is closest to the original, which disturbs composition least.
optionDescriptions.area: Picks the bucket whose total pixel count is closest to the original, favouring the amount of detail over the aspect ratio.
optionDescriptions.pixel: Equivalent to area (the same backend branch).
optionDescriptions.pixels: Equivalent to area (the same backend branch).
optionDescriptions.larger: Considers only buckets at least as wide and tall as the original, then takes the smallest of those -- never shrinks, at the cost of possible padding.
optionDescriptions.ceil: Equivalent to larger (the same backend branch).
optionDescriptions.no_downscale: Equivalent to larger (the same backend branch).
optionDescriptions.smaller: Considers only buckets no wider or taller than the original, then takes the largest of those -- never enlarges, at the cost of a little resolution.
optionDescriptions.floor: Equivalent to smaller (the same backend branch).
optionDescriptions.no_upscale: Equivalent to smaller (the same backend branch).

advanced.principle: 后端 dataset_bucketing.py:111-129 对每个候选桶算一个 diff 再取最小：area/pixel/pixels 用 |原图面积 - 桶面积|；larger/ceil/no_downscale 先跳过任一维小于原图的桶、再用 桶面积 - 原图面积；smaller/floor/no_upscale 先跳过任一维大于原图的桶、再用 原图面积 - 桶面积；其余（含 aspect）用 |原图宽高比 - 桶宽高比|。
advanced.intervention: 改本字段不需要重建缓存桶表，但会改变已有图片落到哪个桶，等价于换了一次数据分布。
advanced.expectedImpact: 对 loss 曲线通常是二阶影响；对「训练图有没有被拉伸/留边」是一阶影响。
advanced.tradeoffs: aspect 保构图但可能改变有效分辨率；area 保细节量但可能轻微拉伸；larger/smaller 各自单边牺牲。

advanced_en.principle: The backend (dataset_bucketing.py:111-129) computes one diff per candidate bucket and takes the minimum: area/pixel/pixels use |image area - bucket area|; larger/ceil/no_downscale first skip any bucket with a dimension smaller than the image, then use bucket area - image area; smaller/floor/no_upscale first skip any bucket with a dimension larger than the image, then use image area - bucket area; the rest (including aspect) use |image aspect ratio - bucket aspect ratio|.
advanced_en.intervention: Changing this field does not require rebuilding the cached bucket table, but it changes which bucket existing images fall into — equivalent to swapping the data distribution once.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Usually a second-order effect on the loss curve; a first-order effect on whether training images get stretched or letterboxed.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: aspect preserves composition but can change effective resolution; area preserves detail volume but can stretch slightly; larger/smaller each sacrifice one side.
